children: Inhibrx reported INBRX-106 plus pembrolizumab achieved a 48.3% confirmed objective response rate and interim median PFS of 9.6 months in Phase 2 first-line HNSCC.
Randomized Phase 2 (n=68; 63 evaluable) showed cORR 48.3% for INBRX-106+pembrolizumab vs 26.5% for pembrolizumab alone.
Median PFS (data cutoff 8/19/2026) was 9.6 months vs 4.9 months; 6‑month PFS rates 72.4% vs 42.8%.
HPV+ subgroup: cORR 80.0% vs 33.3%, CR rate 30.0% vs 0%, and 6‑month PFS 90.0% vs 33.0%; median PFS not reached for combination.
Safety generally manageable; most common TRAEs rash, fatigue, diarrhea, primarily low grade.
Inhibrx will add ~50 HPV+ OPSCC patients to Phase 2 to support potential accelerated pathway and plans Phase 3 confirmatory study thereafter.
